messages.subject: Planned maintenance: DMS offline Saturday 06:00-10:00
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear all,

The document management system (iManage) will be unavailable this Saturday between 06:00 and 10:00 BST for scheduled maintenance and indexing. Please ensure any documents are checked in before Friday close of business. Email will not be affected.

Thank you,
IT Helpdesk
